text:
alex r: Quick heads-up — I'm going to apply a small Terraform change to the ExternalSecrets mapping for staging. It's to switch from the generic `dataFrom` to an explicit vault path mapping for the session-service. PR: https://github.redwood/ses/infra/pull/412. Will watch rotations after deploy.

maria: Thanks — does that require new RBAC or SA permissions in staging?

sam: It shouldn't, but IRSA mapping needs the `secrets/get` policy on the new path. Terraform adds the Vault policy, but double-check the K8s SA annotation: `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` still needs to point to the same role.

nina: FYI saw one reconcile error earlier: `external-secrets-controller: failed to fetch secret from vault: 404 secret not found at path secret/data/team/session` — could be mismatch in path.

infra-bot: [reconcile-failure] external-secrets/session-service (staging) — last seen 2024-11-02T14:08:12Z — error=404 secret not found

alex r: Thanks @nina — that's the case I want to catch. The TF change renames the vault path to `secret/data/team/session-service` (adds `-service`). I pushed a migration script but it's staged. Will run a quick one-off copy if needed.

maria: Can you paste the TF snippet? want to confirm it's only a path variable change.

alex r: Sure — snippet from terraform:```hcl
resource "vault_generic_secret" "session_service" {
  path = "secret/data/team/session-service"
  data_json = jsonencode({
    api_key = var.session_api_key
  })
}
```

sam: Ok looks fine. Two checks: 1) Vault token used by external-secrets has access to `secret/data/team/*` and 2) ExternalSecret CRD `spec.vault.path` updated. If either is old, you'll see 404.

kevin: Ping me when the TF apply is done and drop the PR link here, I'll do a quick smoke test (read + rotate) in staging. Also can review the PR if you want.

alex r: Applied now to staging. PR updated: https://github.redwood/ses/infra/pull/412 — migration run copied existing `secret/data/team/session` -> `.../session-service`.

nina: After apply, controller logs show successful fetch for session-service but there's still one app pointing at the old path: `session-daemonset-3` — error: `no secret matches spec.vault.path`

alex r: I patched the ExternalSecret resource for that daemonset and triggered a reconcile: `kubectl annotate externalsecret session-daemonset-3 redwood/reconcile=triggered` — controller fetched and created k8s secret.

kevin: Running smoke: curl staging-session /health (uses secret). If all good I'll run a quick rotate.

infra-bot: [rotation-job] session-service-rotate (staging) queued by kevin at 2024-11-02T14:17:03Z

kevin: Rotate succeeded. Verified the app picked up new token with no restarts. :thumbsup:

maria: Nice. Two follow-ups: add a short note in the terraform changelog about the path rename, and add a unit test for the migration script.

alex r: Will do both. Thanks for the quick check, everyone.

sam: leaving a small comment on the PR about logging the old path during migration so we can audit failures later.

alex r: Good call. I'll add that and request review from @kevin and @maria.
